title: Computer Vision with PyTorch
description: Train, evaluate, and deploy image models using convolution, augmentation, and transfer learning.
learningOutcomes: Diagnose and deploy a vision model

lessons.title: Images, Tensors, and DataLoaders
lessons.description: Decode, normalize, batch, and visualize image data correctly.

lessons.title: Convolutions and CNN Architectures
lessons.description: Connect receptive fields and learned filters to classification behavior.

lessons.title: Augmentation and Transfer Learning
lessons.description: Reuse pretrained features and apply transformations that preserve labels.

lessons.title: Detection, Segmentation, and Task Choice
lessons.description: Frame visual problems beyond single-label classification.

lessons.title: Vision Evaluation and Deployment
lessons.description: Find slice failures and serve consistent preprocessing with the model.
